name: Metaview
description: Bring Metaview's hiring intelligence into Claude. Search, analyze, and extract insights from your recruiting data. Query conversations, source candidates, and start outreach. Use Claude alongside Metaview's AI agents to turn every conversation and signal into faster, better hiring decisions.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Metaview to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Metaview to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.metaview.ai/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Metaview MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Metaview lists 16 MCP tools, including get_user_context, search_conversations, group_conversations, get_chart_data, list_fields, list_field_values, create_ai_field, create_report, search_reports, get_enrichment_status, list_sequences, and manage_sequence.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Metaview?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Metaview in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
Metaview requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Metaview is developed by Metaview. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
